primary_analysis: Confirmatory analysis computed on the 120 preregistered pairs (completed_episode_count=240 -> 120 pairs). For each pair: read paired records from execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/scoring/task-####-*.json; define success_indicator = (Batfish_result == "pass"). Compute the paired success-rate difference = mean_over_pairs(success_guarded - success_baseline). Report: n_pairs (pairs included in primary analysis after deterministic exclusions), observed guarded and baseline marginal success rates, paired difference (guarded − baseline). Statistical inference: two-sided exact McNemar test (report exact p-value) and paired bootstrap (10,000 replicates, resample pairs with replacement) to produce 95% bootstrap CI for the paired difference. All input fields used: Batfish_result, pair_id, task_id, excluded_flag, wall_clock_time_ms, repair_call_id, initial_generation_call_id.
secondary_analyses: Paired comparison of total model calls per task (total calls observed in the pair records; guarded vs baseline) using paired Wilcoxon (two-sided), Hodges–Lehmann median paired difference, and bootstrap 95% CI (10,000 replicates).

Proportion of tasks passing within N iterations for N=1..6 per condition (derive iterations from presence/absence of repair_call_id and from execution/scoring JSONs); report empirical CDFs and per-N paired differences.
Paired comparison of wall-clock time-to-pass (wall_clock_time_ms from paired records) using paired Wilcoxon and bootstrap 95% CI; report median and IQR per condition.

Exploratory subgroup summaries: per pre-specified failure_type_codes taxonomy (syntax, policy/ACL, topology, routing) report marginal success rates by condition and descriptive paired differences (no confirmatory claims). Apply multiplicity control as below.
sensitivity_analyses: Primary failed-call handling per executor contract identifiers (see failed_call_treatment field) implemented as: (A) complete_pair_primary — exclude pairs flagged by deterministic exclusion rules (excluded_flag present) from primary analysis (this is primary confirmatory treatment); (B) complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity — include excluded/failed pairs by imputing success=0 for missing runs and re-run confirmatory analysis (report both results).

Contamination sensitivity: include pairs flagged under contamination_plan (session_id reuse, >50% localized-feedback-length disparity, retries beyond preregistered policy) and (a) re-run confirmatory estimand with flagged pairs excluded (primary table) and (b) include flagged pairs with conservative imputation (count as failure/max iterations) and report impact on estimand.
Worst-case imputation sensitivity: any pair excluded for infrastructure or canonicalization failure is treated as Maximum-failure (success=0) and re-run confirmatory test; report result.
uncertainty_quantification: Primary: exact McNemar two-sided p-value and paired bootstrap (10,000 replicates) 95% CI for paired success-rate difference. Also report 95% exact/binomial (Clopper–Pearson) CIs for marginal success rates per condition. Secondary/count outcomes: Hodges–Lehmann median paired differences, paired Wilcoxon exact p-values, and bootstrap 95% CIs (10,000 replicates). Report all CIs and p-values to three significant digits and include bootstrap sampling seed and RNG algorithm (Mersenne Twister, seed recorded in execution manifest).
multiplicity_implementation: Primary confirmatory hypothesis: single paired comparison on success rates (guarded vs baseline) on the preregistered 120 pairs. All other tests (secondary outcomes and subgroup comparisons) are pre-specified exploratory; for exploratory subgroup hypothesis tests apply Benjamini–Hochberg FDR control at q=0.05 across those subgroup tests and report both raw and BH-adjusted p-values. Report number of comparisons controlled and full list of tested hypotheses.
contamination_analysis: Follow preregistered contamination_plan: enforce fresh model sessions per run (verify provider call artifacts in execution/provider_calls/*.json and model_session_id in execution/raw_results.jsonl). Detect contamination by: (1) session_id reuse -> flag pair and exclude from primary; (2) identical model output hashes across conditions for a task -> flag; (3) localized-feedback-length disparity >50% for same failure_type_code -> flag. All flagged pairs listed in Table of exclusions with deterministic reason and artifact hashes; primary analysis excludes flagged pairs; sensitivity analyses reintroduce them per sensitivity plan. Record detection metadata from execution/execution_log.jsonl and execution/call_cache/*.
table_specifications: Table 1 — Confirmatory summary: n_pairs included, baseline success rate (count, %), guarded success rate (count, %), paired difference (guarded − baseline) with 95% bootstrap CI, McNemar exact p-value, number of excluded/flagged pairs and deterministic reasons (session_id reuse, canonicalization failure, API infrastructure failure). Source artifacts: execution/scoring/*.json, execution/raw_results.jsonl, execution/execution_log.jsonl.

Table 2 — Secondary outcomes: per-pair distribution summaries (median, IQR) and paired test results for model-call counts and wall_clock_time_ms; Hodges–Lehmann estimates and bootstrap CIs. Source: execution/scoring/*.json, execution/raw_results.jsonl.

Table 3 — Exclusions and contamination audit: list of all excluded/flagged pair_ids, exclusion/flag reason codes, associated artifact hashes (prompt_hash, output_hash, provider_calls file). Source: execution/raw_results.jsonl, execution/execution_log.jsonl, execution/provider_calls/*.json.

Table 4 — Error-class breakdown (exploratory): counts and success rates per failure_type_code by condition and descriptive paired differences; BH-adjusted p-values for subgroup tests. Source: execution/scoring/*.json.
figure_specifications: Figure 1 — Paired dot-and-connector plot: per-task baseline and guarded success (0/1) with connectors showing within-pair change; n=120 pairs (excluded pairs omitted in primary figure). Source: execution/scoring/*.json.

Figure 2 — Bootstrap sampling distribution: histogram/density of paired success-rate difference from 10,000 paired bootstrap replicates with 95% CI marked. Source: primary-analysis bootstrap on execution/scoring data.
Figure 3 — Stacked bar: per-error-class (syntax, policy/ACL, topology, routing) success rates by condition with paired-difference inset. Source: execution/scoring/*.json and failure_type_codes field.
